references.role: STYLE PLATE: four card illustrations in the black-and-gold Art Deco style of this game, cropped from concept art and still standing on their black lacquer card backdrop with small crimson corner triangles. Copy their rendering exactly (polished gold with crisp specular bands, ivory enamel, glossy lacquer, deep crimson and teal enamel, elegant streamlined geometry, fanned gold rays). Do not copy their subjects, their layout, the black backdrop or the corner triangles. The pip colours of the dice on the plate are not a style rule: pips follow the subject.

SUBJECT REFERENCE: the same card drawn in the game's default style. Keep its objects, their arrangement, the idea, and every colour that carries game information: dice pips keep the reference's colours (dark pips stay dark, in the darkest ink of reference image 1; red pips stay red; blue pips stay blue), coloured die faces keep their colour, gold stays gold, and glass or transparent parts stay transparent. Never colour neutral dark pips red or blue. Ignore everything else about its rendering (outlines, shading, halftone, exact shades) and draw it in the style of reference image 1.
